chains.title: TCF7L2 binding change at the pELS element may affect POU5F1B

The variant lies in pELS cCRE EH38E3858447, but the reported activity scores are maxima across biosamples and do not establish activity in HCT116 or an allele-dependent change in element activity.
POU5F1B is a candidate target because it is relatively close and is listed among the cCRE's nearby genes; no direct link from this element to POU5F1B is shown.
HCT116 is a plausible context: TCF7L2 occupancy over the variant and TCF7L2 expression are reported in this line.
If this element changes POU5F1B expression, it could affect colon-cancer cellular traits, but the evidence does not show that rs73706717 does so or that it is associated with colorectal cancer risk.

predictions: In informative HCT116 TCF7L2 ChIP reads, the variant-bearing site should show ref-favored allelic occupancy; this prediction is uncertain because the mapped model describes a weak site.

PMID 22429595 (2012): Characterization of the colorectal cancer-associated enhancer MYC-335 at 8q24: the role of rs67491583.

In our previous work, we showed that the colorectal cancer (CRC) risk variant rs6983267 at 8q24 resides within a TCF4 binding site at the MYC-335 enhancer, with the risk allele G having a stronger binding capacity and Wnt responsiveness.

In this study, rs67491583 was identified as another functional variant in the CRC-associated enhancer MYC-335, but further studies are needed to establish the role of rs67491583 in the colorectal cancer predisposition of African Americans.
